title: SLS jumped 156% yesterday on Phase 3 AML vaccine data. Does the $150Moffering change the thesis?
author: tickeron_community
selftext:
Yesterday (Tuesday, Nov 17), \[SLS\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/SLS/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/SLS/))  
closed at $19.15, up 156% from Monday's $7.47 close. Today (Wednesday,  
Nov 18) it's around $18.40, holding most of that move.  
  
The primary catalyst was the Phase 3 REGAL trial: SELLAS's cancer  
vaccine galinpepimut-S met its primary overall survival endpoint in  
AML. Median OS was 24.0 months vs 14.7 months on standard treatment —  
a 41% lower risk of death — with no new safety signals.  
  
What's next: talks with the FDA on an accelerated pathway, a BLA  
planned for 1H 2027, and more data at ASH (Dec 12–15). After hours  
Tuesday, the company also announced a $150M offering.  
  
Full write-up: [https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-sellas-life-sciences-group-sls-stock-up-157-03-today-39901/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-sellas-life-sciences-group-sls-stock-up-157-03-today-39901/)  
  
Is this a genuine Phase 3 re-rating, or does a 1H 2027 filing plus a  
fresh raise make yesterday's move look stretched?
